events.line: A coach party from Barnsley descends, all hungry, all wanting to know if the peas are mushy. They are. Double takings.
A storm takes the power out for the day. You sell nothing and eat the leftovers by torchlight.
The gulls get at the queue. Customers leave quicker than the chips do.
A man with a notebook orders cod and chips and says 'hm' four times. Word gets around: a good day.
A summer bank holiday. The queue goes round the corner and stops to ask what the queue is for.
The Illuminations are on and the whole prom is hungry. You run out of paper twice.
